findings.issue: Disabled trainer dropdown in schedule creation
findings.description: The schedule creation modal disables the trainer dropdown for Trainer role and adds a hidden input with id='trainerIdHidden'. However, the form submit handler reads document.getElementById('trainerId').value, not 'trainerIdHidden'. If the disabled select doesn't have a value, the POST will be missing trainerId.
findings.recommendation: Verify schedule creation works for Trainer role; if it fails, update the submit handler to read trainerIdHidden when present or use form.elements fallback.

findings.description: The ownership checks in ScheduleService.UpdateAsync and SessionService.UpdateAsync are business-critical security logic, but there's no indication of test coverage. A future refactor could accidentally remove the trainerId comparison.
findings.recommendation: Add unit tests that verify a trainer cannot update another trainer's schedule/session, and that admin can update any resource.
